title: Use of Turmeric in Wound Healing
abstract: A method of promoting healing of a wound by administering turmeric (Curcuma longa) to a patient afflicted with the wound. The turmeric is administered orally or locally in the form of a paste.
claims_summary: Turmeric powder applied to wounds for accelerated healing. Claims topical application of Curcuma longa for wound treatment.
outcome: Revoked in 1997 based on CSIR challenge citing Indian traditional knowledge prior art.

title: Method for Controlling Fungi on Plants Using Hydrophobic Extracted Neem Oil
abstract: A method of controlling fungi on plants comprising the application of hydrophobic extracted neem oil to the plants. The neem oil is derived from Azadirachta indica seeds.
claims_summary: Neem oil as antifungal agent for agricultural use. Claims cold-pressed neem seed oil application on crops.
outcome: Revoked by EPO in 2005 after challenge by Indian government and NGOs citing prior art in traditional Indian agriculture.

title: Herbal Composition for Diabetes Treatment
abstract: A herbal composition comprising Momordica charantia (bitter gourd), Gymnema sylvestre, and Pterocarpus marsupium for lowering blood sugar levels in diabetic patients.
claims_summary: Combination of three herbs in specific ratios for blood sugar control. Claims synergistic anti-diabetic effect.
outcome: Granted; challenged but upheld due to novel ratio and extraction process.

title: Novel Ashwagandha Extract Formulation with Enhanced Bioavailability
abstract: A novel standardized extract of Withania somnifera roots with minimum 5% withanolides combined with piperine from Piper nigrum for enhanced bioavailability. Uses supercritical CO2 extraction.
claims_summary: Ashwagandha root extract standardized to withanolides, bioenhanced with piperine. Novel extraction process using supercritical CO2.
outcome: Granted; overcame Section 3(d) by demonstrating enhanced efficacy through bioavailability data.

title: Boswellia Serrata Extract for Inflammatory Conditions
abstract: Standardized extract of Boswellia serrata gum resin enriched in AKBA (3-O-acetyl-11-keto-beta-boswellic acid) for treating inflammatory conditions including arthritis.
claims_summary: AKBA-enriched Boswellia serrata extract. Claims specific enrichment process yielding >30% AKBA content.
outcome: Granted; novel enrichment process for specific marker compound.

title: Phytopharmaceutical Formulation from Tinospora Cordifolia
abstract: A phytopharmaceutical drug formulation from Tinospora cordifolia (Guduchi/Giloy) standardized to four bioactive markers: berberine, palmatine, tinosporin, and cordifolioside A, complying with Rule 122E requirements.
claims_summary: Guduchi extract standardized to 4 phytochemical markers per CDSCO Rule 122E. Novel purification method achieving minimum marker concentrations.
outcome: Under examination; claimed as phytopharmaceutical under Rule 122E pathway.

title: Composition Containing Curcuminoids for Wound Healing
abstract: Pharmaceutical composition containing curcuminoids isolated from turmeric rhizome in combination with specific carriers for topical wound treatment. Includes stability-enhanced formulation.
claims_summary: Purified curcuminoid fraction with pharmaceutical carriers. Claims improved stability and penetration compared to raw turmeric.
outcome: Granted; differentiated from US5401504 by purified curcuminoid fraction and carrier system.

title: Triphala-Based Oral Care Formulation with Antimicrobial Activity
abstract: An oral care composition based on Triphala (Terminalia chebula, Terminalia bellirica, Emblica officinalis) in 1:1:1 ratio with added menthol and xylitol for enhanced antimicrobial activity against oral pathogens.
claims_summary: Triphala mouthwash formulation with modern excipients. Claims synergistic antimicrobial effect demonstrated through in-vitro studies.
outcome: Faced Section 3(p) challenge for Triphala component; argued novelty in combination with modern excipients.

title: Standardized Brahmi Extract for Cognitive Enhancement
abstract: Bacopa monnieri extract standardized to 50% bacosides, formulated as nanoparticles for improved blood-brain barrier penetration, intended for cognitive enhancement and neuroprotection.
claims_summary: Brahmi nanoparticle formulation with high bacoside content. Novel drug delivery system for neuroprotection.
outcome: Pending national phase entry; novel delivery system may overcome TK bar.

title: Ayurvedic Cosmetic Formulation for Skin Brightening
abstract: A cosmetic formulation containing Manjistha (Rubia cordifolia), Kumkumadi Taila base, saffron extract, and liquorice root for skin brightening without hydroquinone.
claims_summary: Herbal skin brightening formula using traditional Ayurvedic ingredients with modern stabilization. Claims efficacy comparable to synthetic brighteners.
outcome: Filed under cosmetic category; BIS compliance pending.

title: Anti-inflammatory Herbal Composition with Curcumin and Boswellia
abstract: Synergistic anti-inflammatory composition comprising curcumin from Curcuma longa and boswellic acids from Boswellia serrata in a 2:1 ratio, demonstrating superior efficacy compared to individual components.
claims_summary: Curcumin-Boswellia combination in specific ratio with demonstrated synergy. Claims reduction of inflammatory markers beyond additive effect.
outcome: Granted; synergy data overcame Section 3(e) equivalent challenge.

title: Chyawanprash-Based Immune Booster with Vitamin C Enhancement
abstract: Modified Chyawanprash formulation retaining classical base of Amalaki (Emblica officinalis) with 40+ herbs, enhanced with ascorbic acid encapsulation for improved shelf stability and vitamin C bioavailability.
claims_summary: Classical Chyawanprash modified with vitamin C encapsulation technology. Claims improved stability without altering classical herb base.
outcome: Challenged under Section 3(p) for Chyawanprash base; vitamin C encapsulation argued as novel process.
